While of course the best way to get your hair looking great is to make an appointment with our expert stylists, there are a lot of things you can do at home to keep your hair looking great on a day to day basis.

When shampooing, massage in the shampoo, not the conditioner, for about half a minute. For conditioner, just rub it from the tips of your hair towards your head, and let it sit for a little while before washing it out. Use cool or cold water to wash, unless your hair really needs a good soaking.
We all like a treat now and then and your hair is no different. A few minutes of your day once a week if your hair is over processed from bleach, we would highly recommend our intensive range.
Liquid Hair which is a Molecular Refiller, builds the hair back working from the inside.

Elastic Force is an amazing product for when you have a lot of elasticity in your hair from starightening or colouring too much. Spray it on to the hair and then rinse after 5 seconds - you will be amazed with results.
Apha Energy which is a hair and scalp energiser, which improves scalp moisture and reduces hair structure damage.
Cocochoco has the most advanced formula and highest amount of Keratin in its products, making it the most effective Keratin Hair Treatment available.
It strengthens the hair using an intense conditioning remedy, protecting the hair against structural damage.
Leaves hair smoother, healthier and more manageable.
Suitable for both Virgin and Chemically treated and coloured hair
Contains no Harsh Chemicals – NO Formaldahyde, Amonia, Sulphates or Parabens
Protects hair from Pollutants, Chlorine and UV Damage
Prices include after care Shampoo and Conditioner
All prices vary on thickness and length of hair.

Many of us have heard about the hot trend sweeping the red carpets and fashionable circles of the world today, and it's called Balayage. So what is it? In French it means to sweep or paint, and for your hair colouring here in Galway it gives a beautiful, elegant yet wild and natural sun-kissed look.

Balayage is applied freehand and only to the surface, except at the tips of the hair, blending naturally with the rest of your hair in soft shades and tones. Our hair colouring experts at Pazam will match the best balayage colour to your skin and hair, bringing out your natural beauty.
Although fairly new, it's starting to become very popular among celebrities who want something more gentle than the straight lines and hard edges of other hair colouring techniques.

Once you have your balayage done, it needs very little work to keep it looking gorgeous, without much of a growth line, and it's suitable for almost all hair lengths and styles, except very short crops. It's fantastic on light or dark coloured hair too!
So give us a call and make your appointment to share hairstyles with the stars!
